definitions.short: Chammon , the name of two places in Palestine
definitions.full: H2540. Chammon חַמּוֺן proper name, of a location ( hot spring ?) — 1 town in Asher Josh 19:28 . 2 in Naphtali 1Chr 6:61 (perhaps = 1. דּאֹר חַמַּת חַמַּת, , see Be and Di Josh 19:35 ).
